title: Sarkar 3
desc: Gandhi seeks Sarkar's assistance for a project that will displace people. Sarkar refuses, triggering intense conflicts as power, politics, and betrayal take center stage in this gripping story.

title: Wanted
desc: Fearless hitman Radhe operates without mercy for anyone who pays, yet he desperately seeks redemption after falling hard for Jhanvi, who despises his brutal, violent life of crime.

title: Do Raaste
desc: Navendu, a devoted young man, cares for his stepmother and half-brothers, honoring his father's promise. But their family unravels when one brother marries a controlling, wealthy woman.

title: Saand Ki Aankh
desc: Chandro and Prakashi, two women in their 60s, discover their shooting talent. With help from a coach, they challenge patriarchy and compete in national tournaments.

title: Manikarnika : The Queen Of Jhansi
desc: Manikarnika, queen of Jhansi, refuses British rule and leads a fiery rebellion. Her courage turns into a historic fight for freedom against the East India Company's oppression.

title: Coolie No. 1 (1995)
desc: A matchmaker plots to humble arrogant rich man Hoshiyar Chand by having Raju, a coolie, pose as a millionaire, leading to hilarious chaos as Raju tries to win his daughter's hand.

title: Suhaag
desc: Ajay and Raj, notorious college pranksters, constantly land in trouble. When Ajay applies for a passport, he uncovers a shocking secret about his real identity, changing his life.

title: Vijaypath
desc: Justice Saxena sentences a criminal to death. Seeking revenge, Dilawar Singh kills the judge's family and driver. The driver's son, devastated, vows to fight back and settle the score.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Commando - A One Man Army
desc: Karan, an Indian commando, is arrested by Chinese officials after a crash. Accused of spying, he must escape from their tough prison camp using all his skills.

title: Taal
desc: Mansi rises to fame with Vikrant's help after being insulted. But when her ex apologises and wants her back, she must choose between past pain and present success.

title: Love In Tokyo
desc: Ashok loves Asha, but his mother wants him to marry Sarita. After a tragic accident leaves Ashok blind, his life and relationships become painfully complicated.

title: Tarla
desc: Tarla Dalal, determined to make something meaningful of her life, defies societal norms and uses her passion for cooking to empower herself and inspire countless women to pursue their dreams.

title: Mom
desc: Devki, a biology teacher, turns to private detective DK after her stepdaughter's rapists are acquitted. Fueled by anguish, she vows revenge and sets out to deliver justice herself.

title: Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara
desc: Kabir, Imran, and Arjun set off on a vacation in Spain before Kabir's wedding, where the journey helps them mend bonds, heal old wounds, embrace life, and face their deepest fears.

title: Little John
desc: John seeks a guru's help to impress his girlfriend's parents but ends up shrinking instead of turning invisible. To reverse it, he must find a powerful magic ring.

title: Chaalbaaz
desc: Separated twins Anju and Manju grow up differently and accidentally swap lives. Shy Anju enters a rustic world, while bold Manju bravely takes revenge on their evil uncle.
